resources.string: Navigation, panels, content changes and expanding sections share consistent timing. Reduced motion applies to panels and content resizing, and system changes are picked up without restarting the app.
Filters, theme palettes, settings and tool menus have consistent touch feedback. Search focus is clearer, switches have larger touch targets, and onboarding follows the same animation settings.
